model: Supplied 2D compressible single-fluid MHD, gamma=5/3, alpha=20, temperature=3, pressureOffset=6, spatially uniform explicit eta; no physical variant
normalization: L0=B0=rho0=vA0=1; S_eta=1/eta is nominal inverse resistivity
observable: Guided center-flux increment from By integral, cross-checked with independent Bx path; R=0.04/(first t(flux=.05)-first t(flux=.01))
numerics: HLLD, second order MC, constrained magnetic divergence control, adaptive CFL=.8 conditional on .4 parity; diffusion timestep factor=.8; dtmax=.01; four MPI ranks 2x2; cadence=.025

eligibility.topology_scope: Symmetric center sheet |x|<.25, cumulative By along y=0; secondary flux extrema prominence>=1e-4 separated by>=4 cells. Field/current plots and diagnostic line profiles audited; subthreshold, off-axis and between-output islands are not excluded. No noise/perturbation added.

uncertainty: Deterministic numerical sensitivity, not a rigorous continuum bound or random sampling CI. Per-case relative log-rate margin is 2 times observed matched-grid log-rate difference (use largest matched difference for unrefined cases), plus maximum relative variation among both flux paths and cadence-decimated trajectories, plus CFL parity difference. Use at least .01 log-rate margin. Also report conservative first-crossing bracket bounds. Report residual-based Student-t 95% regression intervals separately as model-fit diagnostics, not independent stochastic replicates. Missing cadence/path variants are explicit unresolved diagnostic failures, never silently ignored. Only physically eligible matched pairs passing <=10% difference supply convergence information; declared refinement cases require their own qualified pair. Missing gaps are null/unresolved, never zero. Borrowed margins for intermediate cases come only from qualified pairs. Crossing brackets are conservative cadence-only diagnostics; adjacent slopes diagnose curvature, while exclusion uses joint feasibility/refinement persistence.
fit: OLS log(R) versus log(S), full five-point base grid and common three-point base/refined grids; adjacent slopes as curvature diagnostics. Propagate per-case log-rate boxes linearly to OLS slope min/max. Linear feasibility over slope p and intercept a tests whether all eligible rate boxes admit a single power law with p in [-.60,-.40].
decision: Request falsification only if eligible converged observations give a numerical slope interval disjoint from [-.60,-.40], or no power law in that band fits their predeclared error boxes and that exclusion persists on common refined samples. Band overlap alone is inconclusive. Support can be finite sampled consistency only; do not assert proof for all continuously varying S. Underresolved, secondary-island or unreached-window cases are exclusions/censoring, never counterexamples. Original universal scope remains unchanged.
cost_policy: Continuation fresh five-point N256 scan tmax=.6,.85,1.2,1.6,2.15 and N384 S250/S1000; high-S matched-grid historical diagnostic only. Maintain compute deadline and 450s report reserve. Missing refinement or coverage remains unresolved.
limitations: No integrated floor/source correction output; sampled positivity and budgets cannot exclude all corrections
No dimensional calibration or kinetic physics
FWHM and refinement are empirical resolution diagnostics, not certified continuum error enclosures
Continuous parameter-domain universal support is beyond finite scan
